decisions.reason: The camera rests directly on the firm's optical and star-tracker heritage and has its own page, so the firm can interpret mission feedback and refine it through in-house R&D.
The modular camera line uses existing optoelectronic know-how and fits the strategy of compact sensors for small satellites, so learning from customers carries across its several models.
Space situational awareness is an adjacent, growing field, and the firm's university and EU research ties give it the related knowledge to absorb early results and improve the suite.
The miniaturized LiDAR builds on the firm's docking and rendezvous sensor expertise, and long space qualification cycles make dropping it early premature despite its low website visibility.
A radiation-hard camera line sits at the core of the firm's space-grade imaging competence and has its own page, so the firm can readily assimilate feedback and extend the models.

Asteroid navigation imaging extends proven navigation camera know-how into mission-specific work, likely tied to agency projects, so the firm has the knowledge to develop it even though the website only mentions it.
